members.name: lead
members.purpose: Turn the request into a plan, assign the parts, and deliver one checked result.

members.name: finder
members.description: Hand it any 'where is X / what handles Y' question about the codebase.
members.purpose: Locate the code that answers a question and return path:lines with a one-line reason each.
procedure: Pick 2-4 identifiers or phrases from the question.
Grep and Glob for them; Read only the matching line ranges, never whole files.
Quote the line that proves each hit.
Return at most 10 hits, best first.

members.name: fixer
members.description: Hand it one change with a clear objective, the files it may touch and acceptance criteria.
members.purpose: Make one scoped code change and prove it with the plugin tests.
members.output: Summary of the change, with files and line ranges.
procedure: Restate the objective and acceptance in one line each; if either is unclear, stop with exit blocked.
Read the relevant code (ask finder via SendMessage if you don't know where it is).
Make the smallest change that meets the acceptance.
Run make test and compare with the baseline of 0 failures.

members.name: checker
members.description: Hand it a finished change from fixer, with the acceptance criteria.
members.purpose: Check a finished change against its acceptance criteria and the diff, and report pass or fail with evidence.
procedure: Read git diff for the changed files.
Check each acceptance criterion against the diff; cite path:lines.
Run make test and compare with the baseline of 0 failures.
Flag changes outside the stated objective.
